# `morphir mck node-address run`

- **Usage:** `morphir mck node-address run <FLAGS>`

## Flags
- **`--kit <KIT>`** — Fixed V3/V4 node-address case file

  **Default:** `spec/ir/mck/node-address-draft.json`
- **`--adapter <ADAPTER>`** — Adapter executable, launched without a shell
- **`--adapter-arg <ADAPTER_ARGS>…`** — Adapter argument; repeat to pass --suite node-address
- **`--report <REPORT>`** — Write the JSON report to this file
- **`--timeout <TIMEOUT>`** — Maximum milliseconds per adapter exchange

  **Default:** `30000`
